name: jungle-healing
flavor_text: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
effect_text_extend: Each Pokemon on the user's side has its status condition healed and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded up.
